notes: v1.29: Runs on any Python 3.8+ (version-agnostic launcher). Limits, honestly: Python 3.8 or newer only (openpyxl 3.1.5 requires >=3.8; Python 2 / 3.7 and older cannot run it), that Python must have tkinter (python.org installer includes it by default) and openpyxl installed for that exact interpreter (packages are per-Python, never shared). How it works, in the .bat files only: Setup.bat writes the exact interpreter it found into python_used.txt, and the icon, Debug and Safe bats use that locked Python first — so installing a new Python later cannot silently switch the icon to a fresh interpreter with no openpyxl; re-running Setup re-locks to the new Python. If the locked Python was uninstalled, the launcher falls through to the normal search (312-315 paths, then py launcher, then PATH), so a future version still works via the py launcher once Setup has installed openpyxl for it. python_used.txt is not in the zip and survives in-app updates. Includes v1.28 (Python 3.15 listed in Setup/launcher/Debug/Safe), v1.27 (auto-return on weight difference with auto remarks), v1.26 (startup crash now visible, not silent under pythonw), v1.25 (weight numbers only, scrollable Dashboard + shortcuts help), v1.24 (Space always jumps to table, not Enter), v1.23 (Bill No. renamed to Bill No./Rokar/Book everywhere), v1.22 (Sold column green only when sold, not when Opening = Returned), v1.21 (simpler live rates banner, no buttons, gold/silver only), v1.20 (live MCX banner from mcxlive.org, gold per 10 g, silver per 1 kg), v1.19 (B/Space shortcuts, sale -> Amount, 4-decimal weights, Attendance tab), v1.18 (Box Out horizontal scrolling), v1.17 (Return->Sell notification), v1.16 (return first then sell), v1.15 (version always visible), v1.14 (gold cell, autocomplete), v1.13 (gold row/field/header), v1.12 (horizontal sale row), v1.11 (keyboard Sell panel, Added column, Reset), v1.10 (manual cell entry), v1.9 (table fix), v1.8 (crash-proof startup), v1.7 (empty Return), v1.6 (keyboard-first), v1.5 (GOLD/SILVER), v1.4 (client installer), v1.3 (sale Mode/Amount/Bill No.), v1.2 (no cmd window), v1.1 (Ramanand Jewellers, gold icon).
